map.→ 打开连作障碍指数估算器工具: -> Open the continuous cropping obstacle index estimator tool
map.三类：土传病原菌与线虫积累、自毒物质（根系分泌物）累积、特定养分连年偏耗导致失衡: Three types: accumulation of soil-borne pathogens and nematodes, build-up of autotoxic substances (root exudates), and imbalance from repeatedly depleting a specific nutrient. The three often overlap, which is why rotation is the most effective.
map.不一定。可轮作非寄主作物、嫁接入抗病砧木、增施有机肥与生物菌剂、夏季太阳能消毒。: Not necessarily. You can rotate to non-host crops, graft onto resistant rootstocks, add more organic fertiliser and beneficial microbes, and use solarisation in summer. The index only indicates the risk level, so choose measures by cost and benefit.
map.五因子加权（0~100）：① 年限因子 = min(连作年限 ÷ (安全年限 ×: Five weighted factors (0~100): ① Years factor = min(continuous cropping years ÷ (safe years × 2), 1) × 100; ② Sensitivity factor = crop sensitivity ÷ 10 × 100; ③ Pathogen density factor = density grade ÷ 5 × 100; ④ Soil condition factor takes the mean of the organic matter and pH band scores (higher organic matter scores lower, so does pH 6~7.5); ⑤ Management factor takes the lower of the resistant-variety and disinfection band scores. Index >70 severe obstacle, >50 moderate, >30 mild, otherwise safe.

map.连作障碍指数估算器，综合连作年限、作物敏感性与土壤状况评估障碍风险并分级，指导轮: Continuous cropping obstacle index estimator: combines years of continuous cropping, crop sensitivity and soil condition to assess and grade obstacle risk, guiding rotation and soil improvement.
map.障碍指数 = 年限因子 × 0.30 + 敏感性因子 × 0.20 + 病原菌密: Obstacle index = years factor × 0.30 + sensitivity factor × 0.20 + pathogen density factor × 0.25 + soil condition factor × 0.15 + management factor × 0.10
map.：连续 4 年种番茄、根结线虫史阳性、钾偏耗。按年限(4年=中)、病害(有=高): : 4 consecutive years of tomatoes, positive root-knot nematode history, potassium depletion. Weighting years (4 years = medium), disease (present = high) and nutrients (potassium-biased = medium) gives an index of 68/100, which is high risk, so a fallow break or grafted rootstock plus solarisation is advised.
